title.narrative: SOCIAL PROTECTION FOR GENDER EMPOWERMENT AND RESILIENCE

description.narrative: policy , coordination, systems and capacity strentheningh; integrated capacity building; Innovation and digital solutionss for enhanced social protection ; accountability and coordination systems ; sustainable and shock sensitive social protection financing; Evidence generation and learning ; local governance and decentralization for social sectors ; resilience and livelihood enhancements; access to social services. The SP GEAR will enhance, coordination, implementation, gender and shock sensitivity and monitoring of the Social Cash Transfer programme through reforms and innovation and also enhance the participation of women and girls from vulnerable households in gender-responsive and cost-effective economic empowerment activities that support ultra-poor graduation. The programme will also increase women and girls participation in the household and community structures.
